title: generate_speech arguments
description: Turn written words into spoken audio. Use when the user wants something read aloud, a narration, a voiceover, a line of dialogue, an audiobook passage, expressive acting speech, or a voice cloned from a recording they uploaded or from a saved persona's voice recording. This tool speaks text; it does not compose music — use generate_music for songs and instrumentals.

prompt.description:
The exact words to be spoken, verbatim. This is NOT a description of the audio: whatever is written here is read aloud character for character. "a calm woman reading the news" would be spoken as those seven words — put that in voiceDescription instead and write the actual news copy here.

LITERAL PROMPT OVERRIDE: If the user explicitly says not to modify the prompt, or to use it exactly/verbatim/as-is, copy the identified prompt text verbatim instead of applying these construction rules unless a hard requirement is missing.

With model="drama3" (Fish Drama 3), inline acting directions in square brackets or whisper tags — such as [sighs], [laughs], [warmly], [gasps], or <whisper>...</whisper> — may be placed directly inside prompt to cue vocal delivery without being spoken literally. Do not place bracketed stage directions inside prompt for Qwen3-TTS modes ("voice", "clone", "design"), where they would be read aloud.

Punctuation is prosody: full stops, commas, question marks and ellipses control pauses and intonation, so keep them. Write numbers, dates, currency and abbreviations the way they should be said ("nineteen eighty-four", "twelve dollars fifty", "Doctor Chen") when the plain form would be ambiguous. Line breaks are not pauses; use punctuation.

If the user asks for a script rather than supplying one — "read me a poem about the sea", "record an intro for my podcast" — write the words first and pass them here. compose_script is for longer or structured pieces; a sentence or two you can simply write.

Limit 4096 characters, roughly five minutes of speech. A longer script is refused rather than cut off mid-sentence, so split it across several calls at a natural break.

model.description: Which speech model to use, chosen by what the user gave you. "voice" (default, Qwen3-TTS 1.7B): one of nine studio voices, optionally restyled by voiceDescription — the right choice for narration, voiceover and dialogue when no particular person is being imitated. "clone" (Qwen3-TTS 1.7B): reproduces a specific voice from a recording the user uploaded or a resolved persona's voice recording; requires voiceSourceIndex or voice_source_url. "design" (Qwen3-TTS 1.7B): invents a speaker who does not exist from a written description; requires voiceDescription and takes no recording. "drama3" (Fish Drama 3): expressive acting speech supporting inline [direction] and <whisper>...</whisper> tags directly in prompt, with optional zero-shot voice cloning via voiceSourceIndex / voice_source_url and optional voiceTranscript. Pick "drama3" when the user asks for Fish Drama 3, expressive acting delivery with inline direction tags, or Drama 3 cloning; pick "clone" whenever the user uploads a voice clip or asks for a saved persona's own voice without requesting Drama 3; pick "design" when they describe a speaker instead of choosing one.

voice.description: Studio voice to speak in. Only used when model="voice". Female: serena (English), vivian (Chinese), ono_anna (Japanese), sohee (Korean). Male: ryan, aiden, eric, dylan (English), uncle_fu (older, Chinese). Every voice speaks all supported languages — the note above describes the accent it carries, not a limit on what it can read. Default: serena.

voiceDescription.description: How the line should be delivered, or who should deliver it. With model="voice" this restyles the chosen voice without changing who it is: "whispering, close to the microphone", "furious", "reading a bedtime story", "like a sports commentator". With model="design" this is required and describes a speaker to invent: age, gender, accent, timbre, pace, mood, and recording space — "a warm, unhurried narrator in her forties with a faint Scottish lilt, close-miked in a quiet room". Describe one coherent person; contradictory directions produce a voice that shifts mid-sentence. Not accepted with model="clone" or model="drama3" (for drama3, place inline [direction] tags directly inside prompt). Limit 512 characters.

voiceSourceIndex.description: Which audio holds the voice to clone, using the same numbering every other tool uses for audio: negative indices are uploads (-1 = first/primary upload, -2 = second upload, and so on) and 0-based non-negative indices are audio generated earlier in this conversation. A clip the user just uploaded is -1. A resolved persona's full voice recording uses the index resolve_personas reports. Required when model="clone", optional when model="drama3" (1-30 seconds), and ignored otherwise. For Qwen3-TTS clone mode the clip should be three to thirty seconds of one person speaking cleanly, with no music, no second speaker and no heavy room echo; anything past thirty seconds is trimmed.

voice_source_url.description: REST alternative to voiceSourceIndex: retrievable original recording URL for clone mode or optional drama3 voice cloning.

voiceTranscript.description: The exact words spoken in the uploaded reference clip, when model="clone" or when cloning a reference recording with model="drama3". Supplying it lets the model condition on the recording itself rather than on a speaker fingerprint alone, which is markedly closer to the source — set it whenever the user tells you what the clip says or the transcript is otherwise known. Omitting it still produces a recognisable clone (on drama3, an omitted reference transcript is auto-transcribed). Leave it out for a persona voice recording: the persona's saved transcript is filled in automatically. Limit 1024 characters on model="clone" and 2000 characters on model="drama3".

language.description: Language of the script. Default "auto", which infers it from the text and is the only setting that reads a code-switched line correctly. Pin a language only when auto mis-reads a name, a loanword, or a passage that is ambiguous between two of them. Cloning is cross-lingual: an English reference clip can read Japanese in the same voice.

creativity.description: Qwen3-TTS (voice, clone, design) speech delivery variation from 0.1 to 2; default 0.9. Omit when model="drama3".

numberOfVariations.description: Number of takes (1-16). Each take is a separate read of the same script with the same voice, differing only in delivery. Use more than 1 when the user asks for options or alternate reads. Default: 1.
